script_text: Stop, Taurus — Mars is pressing a hard square to your Sun right now, and it's striking your 5th House of Romance, Risk, and Money. Mars at fifteen degrees Leo squares your Sun, while your ruling planet Venus, the Earth planet that anchors you, sits in serious Capricorn inside your 10th House of Career, tangling desire with ambition. Love: a committed partner may push for a serious talk you're not ready to give, while singles attract a bold fire-sign flirt who wants more than dinner. Career: Venus in your 10th puts a raise or promotion on the table, but refuse any speculative bet while Mars squares your Sun. Warning: Saturn in your 12th House of Hidden Enemies says guard your sleep, your secrets, and your energy tonight. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you don't miss the money window opening this Thursday.
